# LibYAML

Unmodified parser sources and public/private headers from LibYAML 0.2.5:
https://github.com/yaml/libyaml/tree/0.2.5

Only api, reader, scanner, parser and loader are compiled. Version macros
are supplied in build.zig. License is MIT (see License).
Used for SKILL.md YAML frontmatter; no YAML object construction or script
execution is involved. Input frontmatter is capped at 64 KiB.
